subject: 2023 License Renewals and El Tacuba Status
overview: The Commission approved annual liquor license renewals and applications for entertainment and ownership transfers. The board specifically conditioned one renewal on an explanation for a long-term business closure and discussed updated municipal population estimates.

items.title: Medford Brewing Company Entertainment License
items.summary: Approved an entertainment license for performers, devices, and patrons following a discussion on acoustic music and plans to close by 10:00 PM.

items.title: Chili Garden Ownership Transfer
items.summary: Approved the transfer of stock and change of officers for Chili Garden to new owners Jing, Wang, and Zhang.

items.title: 2023 Liquor License Renewals
items.summary: Approved the annual renewal list for all alcohol and wine/malt establishments, noting that Carol's and Wingstop did not seek renewal.

items.title: El Tacuba Renewal Contingency
items.summary: Conditioned the renewal of El Tacuba's license on the owner providing a satisfactory written explanation for why the business has remained closed for four years.

items.title: Departmental Updates
items.summary: Received updates regarding ongoing renovations at Deep Cuts and reviewed preliminary census data showing the city population has increased to approximately 62,000.
